subject.title: feat(bootstrap): teach compact writing style for workspace templates

question: Should the default bootstrap prompt require compact style for all generated workspace files, including USER.md and IDENTITY.md, or only for agent-authored operational instruction files?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes the default style and persona/profile guidance for new workspaces; source correctness alone cannot determine the intended product tradeoff between token economy and expressive customization.

options.title: Limit compact guidance to operational files
options.body: Apply the rule to files such as AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, and TOOLS.md while explicitly preserving user/profile content when nuance is valuable.

options.title: Adopt an all-files compact default
options.body: Keep the broad instruction, but document that humans may override it and prove first-run output preserves required profile and behavior information.

recommendation.title: Limit compact guidance to operational files
recommendation.body: Apply the rule to files such as AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, and TOOLS.md while explicitly preserving user/profile content when nuance is valuable.
